headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Dealing with a Clogged Main Drain
articleBody: Dealing with a clogged main drain can be super frustrating, but making a few common mistakes can turn a nuisance into a major headache. First off, don't ignore it. A slow drain that gradually gets worse isn't going to fix itself; it's a sign of a growing problem that could lead to a massive backup if left unchecked. Second, avoid relying solely on chemical drain cleaners. While they seem like a quick fix, they often just eat away at the clog without fully clearing it, and they can be really harsh on your pipes, sometimes causing corrosion or further damage. Third, don't try to use a small, flimsy auger designed for a sink on a main drain. Main drains require specialized, heavy-duty equipment to truly clear blockages effectively and without damaging your system. Fourth, don't assume a recurring clog is always a simple fix. If the same drain keeps clogging, there might be a deeper issue, like tree root intrusion or a broken pipe, that needs a professional assessment. Lastly, don't delay calling a professional.
